archived_previous_capture.qualification: The former code requested viewmode lit through world console execution and wrote a hardcoded Lit label without active-viewport readback. Historical images must not be treated as verified Lit solely from that label.

exact_diff_reviewed: Read actual active editor viewport mode; set VMI_LIT through supported AutomationLibrary active-viewport API; read back and assert VMI_LIT.
Assert active viewport configuration key remains the captured key before screenshot request.

Record actual prior mode, verified mode and active viewport key in capture receipt. Camera/FOV setup, screenshot dimensions and unique existing-image protection otherwise retain their previous behavior.

installed_api_evidence.description: Reflected BlueprintCallable active-viewport setter and getter; getter returns VMI_Unknown on failure. Capture asserts the known Lit result rather than accepting an unknown or a requested string.

alternative_readback_findings.deferred_get_viewport_camera: UnrealMCPEditorCommands.cpp:1192-1200 selects the first non-null level viewport client, without selecting the actual active or perspective viewport. Its zero camera/FOV90/Unlit result is not evidence of the matched wide screenshot client.
alternative_readback_findings.roadbld_current_capture: RoadBLDFeedbackToolset.cpp:42-62 prefers GCurrentLevelEditingViewportClient when valid and perspective; Current preserves framing. It reads that framebuffer after four settle frames and returns camera location/rotation, but no view-mode or lighting-showflag fields. It only temporarily suppresses and restores selection/outline/widgets.
alternative_readback_findings.showflags_limit: The new reflected getter verifies view mode. It is not a separate readback of every custom lighting/show flag; no such flag getter was found in the reviewed LevelEditor/UnrealEditor subsystem declarations.

concrete_scope: Only native camera/FOV positioning, viewport invalidation, active viewport mode set/readback, actual screenshot request and task-local capture receipts. No light actors, lighting assets, material graph, geographic data, actor geometry, vendor/source packages, Content save, Cook or Bake are modified by this correction.
capture_completion_requirement: The screenshot task remains asynchronous and receipt requested=true does not prove pixels completed. Root must wait for actual valid PNG completion, inspect the actual image, and obtain fresh close/middle/wide verified Lit evidence after restoring the chosen material recipe. Temporary actor or material diagnostic changes must be restored before any named save.
acceptance: Actual shader appearance, matched image quality, named persistence and user acceptance remain separate from this source approval.
